scripts.start: node scripts/setup-env.js && npm run db:up && npm run dev
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: cd server && dotnet watch run --launch-profile https
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up db -d
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it pongapp-db psql -U pingpongdev -d poang
